filter.rule: housemates whose gambit_periods cover week N never enter the poll matrix
filter.applies_in: src/poll_matrix.py build_matrix (poll-matrix-engine-spec.md §6 matrix-exclusion) — the poll engine's only Gambit rule
filter.dashboard: auto-finalists strip: photo + name + status, no share and no win number
filter.note: Supersedes the MCMC-era zero-out filter: the poll engine removes Gambit members from aggregation entirely, so the podium and P(#1)/top-3/top-5 chips rank matrix housemates only. gambit_flag_i_t = 1 iff week t is in that housemate's gambit_periods. Driven entirely by this file; inert from week 6 (Flora/Aikou released).

legacy_mcmc_formula.formula: WinProb_i = 0.0 if gambit_flag_i_t == 1 else exp(mu_i) / sum_{j not gambit} exp(mu_j)
legacy_mcmc_formula.applies_in: retired MCMC posterior predictive — historical reference only, not on the run path

notes: Week-1 public vote (Flora 29.18%, Aikou 9.10%) elected The Gambit: immunity from week-1 eviction + automatic finale slot + ineligible for the grand prize. Release event returned both to prize eligibility from week 6. Backfilled weeks 1-5 standings must apply the filter to Flora/Aikou; weeks 6+ apply to nobody. Sources: docs/season-recon.md.
